tools.name: rearrangeDOMComponents
tools.description: Rearranges the user's home dashboard by adding, removing, or reordering smart home control components based on the user's intent.

componentIds.description: Array of component IDs to display on the dashboard. Examples: 'thermostat_control', 'camera_front_door', 'lock_front_door', 'smart_lights_living_room', 'energy_summary', 'weather_widget', 'media_player_living_room', 'alarm_panel', 'air_quality_sensor', 'robot_vacuum', 'solar_grid'
